name: Higuchi Subaru
source:
He's the reclusive president of an IT company.
He has an uncooperative contrarian personality, a stubborn person who only believes in his own thoughts.
Because of his appearance he received some kind of trauma in his past and has come to hate people. And he has shut himself away and never appeared in front of people ever since.
He's eager to find company that he can relax around.
His flower is the Baby's Breath.
